notes: Pinned interfaces beyond the PRD text: app.routers.terminal.OUT_Q_MAX_BYTES (module int, read at call time); app.herdr.server_alive(timeout) -> bool (any newline-terminated JSON reply = alive); settings.probe_timeout; terminal._spawn(session, rows, cols) -> (pid, fd) forks unconditionally (the binary check lives in the route); terminal.reset_live_count() zeroes the live-terminal counter (tests only).

Backend checks run in the repo-local venv backend/.venv-test (gitignored): create it once, outside the network namespace, with `backend/tests/make_test_venv.sh` (requirements.txt constrained to the deployed freeze + pinned test tools).
composer.ts exports DUP_WINDOW_MS (1500); replacements are grapheme-prefix-minimal (PRD 4.1).
Builders must keep the wrapped-URL link provider (src/wrapLinks.ts, wired in useHerdrTerminal.ts by 3e78f69).

Skeleton change: socketPolicy.onClose(code, reason, everOpened, failStreak) + export NEVER_OPENED_LIMIT (a pure function cannot count 'N closes without opening'). A refusal message contains the server's close reason.

Page facts pinned by the e2e: modifier indicator `.mod-ind` (visible while armed); toasts `.toast` / `.toast.bad`; the connection message is visible page text; Mic button `button.mic-btn`, delivery via POST /api/panes/<id>/send-text then /send-keys.
C-14's tray Enter/^C textarea clear is verified by the C-15 e2e scenario `tray-clear`.
e2e items (network: true) need HW_BUILD_ENV pointing at an env file (outside the repo) with the BUILD_* variables.

P2 lane E: the cutover contract (deploy/cutover.sh CLI, host-env keys, exit codes, STATE_DIR layout, manifest and result.json schemas, how a herdr server is recognised) is pinned in backend/tests/acceptance/cutover_world.py. E-F* run fully offline: fake herdr API server + fake herdr CLI (tests/fakes/herdr_cli.py), fake systemctl / systemd-run / notify on PATH (tests/fakes/systemd_fake.py), fake web (tests/fakes/web_fake.py); assertions are on the recorded ledger and the fake server's input/status logs.

Live checks E-1..E-7 (backend/tests/live/e_checks.py) need HW_HOST_ENV = the host-values file deploy/cutover.sh reads (outside the repo; it also names HOST_NAME, and each check refuses on any other machine). All are read-only probes except E-3, which restarts the web unit once and refuses unless HW_E3_RESTART_OK=1 and E-2 holds. E-1 refuses to dry-run live until E-F1 is verified. They are red until the cutover has run.

V-1..V-3 replace the owner's real-phone sign-off (2026-11-15): Playwright WebKit (playwright 1.60.0 / webkit-2287, pinned in frontend/e2e/vm_ssh.sh, installed by setup_vm_webkit.sh) with the iPhone 15 profile, run ON THE BUILD VM by check_vm.sh (needs HW_BUILD_ENV); screenshots land in frontend/e2e/results/shots/ (gitignored) for a model review. They pass on main (P1 shipped the fixes), so they are guards ("guard": true), not prove-red items; watched failing on a pre-P1 build (2026-11-15): V-1 dictation-composition / rewrite-composition / tray-enter, V-2 all four, V-3 late-enter all FAIL there. Linux WebKit does not turn a touch tap into a click, so tray keys are pointer clicks.
B-6 is a locked test (test_b6.py), no longer a visual checklist.
